Fixed the commerce edge cases in [priceCart.js](/Users/nihal/code/Prompt/prmpt-cli/harness/results/codex-cli-20260628-070349/_work/atlas-p3-codex-r1-8dd9ac/src/checkout/priceCart.js:1) and [reserveInventory.js](/Users/nihal/code/Prompt/prmpt-cli/harness/results/codex-cli-20260628-070349/_work/atlas-p3-codex-r1-8dd9ac/src/fulfillment/reserveInventory.js:1).

What changed:
- Null/missing coupons no longer crash pricing.
- Coupons without a valid numeric percent are ignored.
- Cart items can price from either `unitPrice` or catalog-style `price`.
- Duplicate cart items now sum quantity while keeping the newest item metadata/price.
- Missing SKUs in batch reservation return `{ ok: false, remaining: 0, reserved: 0 }` instead of crashing.
- `reserveBatch` now accepts both `{ products: [...] }` catalogs and raw product arrays.

Verified with `npm test`: all 7 tests pass.
